interface.evidence: Original interface specifies only input in (32 bits) and output out (32 bits).

semantics.operation: Reverse the order of four bytes, preserving bit order within each byte.
semantics.timing: Combinational; no clock, reset, or added latency because original interface has only in and out.
semantics.initialization: No stored state or specified initial value; output reflects current input including four-state bits.

numeric.arithmetic: None; unsigned bit permutation without bit reversal.

verification.oracle: For each input bit i, compare output bit (3-i/8)*8+i%8 with input bit i, directly from original byte reversal requirement.
verification.sampling: Drive input then wait 1 ns for combinational settling.
cases: all walking one and walking zero positions
unknown and high impedance bit propagation
verification.failure: Case inequality with $fatal, bounded timeout, PASS only after every check.
